behavior_constraints: unpivot stage reshapes wide records to long form, emitting one row per measure per input record
id is a required non-empty ordered list; a record missing an id column is treated as empty string for that column (no abort); duplicate id names are a config error
exactly one of measures or measures_match must be supplied; both or neither is a config error
measures is a non-empty ordered list; duplicates are a config error; a name appearing in both id and measures is a config error

measures_match has optional prefix/suffix/regex selectors composed with AND; at least one selector required; empty-string selectors are config errors; candidate set is record keys minus id and exclude columns
invalid regex in measures_match is a config error
exclude is optional, only valid with measures_match; supplying exclude with measures is a config error
variable is required unless axes is supplied; must be non-empty and differ from every id column and from value; mutually exclusive with axes; supplying neither is a config error
axes is optional, mutually exclusive with variable; requires measures_match with non-empty regex; non-empty list of axis specs each with name and group
axis name must be non-empty, unique across axes, differ from id and value; unknown keys in axis spec are config errors
affected_prior: Build in internal/stage/stage.go (must dispatch new unpivot type)
StageConfig in internal/config/config.go (must carry unpivot configuration)
entities.summary: Add an `unpivot` stage that reshapes wide records into long form with id/measures/measures_match/variable-or-axes/value selectors and drop_empty/on_missing/sort/value_type options, without changing existing behavior.

instruction_head:
# Add an `unpivot` stage (wide-to-long reshape)

Add an `unpivot` stage for wide-to-long reshaping. All existing
behavior remains unchanged.

## New stage: `unpivot`

```yaml
- type: unpivot
  id: [region, customer]               # required, non-empty
  measures: [q_Q1, q_Q2, q_Q3]         # mutually exclusive with measures_match
  measures_match:                      # mutually exclusive with measures
    prefix: q_                         # zero-or-more selectors below
    suffix: _amt
    reg
